level.title: Upgrade Your Minion
level.subdescription:
Your Minion has a base, knows the data, and has answered every mission question. Now ask it for a presentation and you get whatever it feels like making that day.
Ask once, install a Skill, carry your findings into a fresh chat, and make the same ask again.

mission_targets: Ask for a presentation with no Skill loaded and keep the result
Install a Skill that trains your Minion to build decks a proven way
Carry your findings into a fresh chat and make the same ask with the Skill on
Understand why a Skill beats a longer prompt for anything you do repeatedly

mission_gear.name: Skills
mission_gear.definition: A reusable instruction file that teaches Claude how to handle one type of task properly — loaded once, then applied automatically every time that task comes up.
mission_gear.theme_translation: Think of it as sending your Minion to specialist school. Before, they improvise and hope. After, they follow a proven method every single time. Same Minion, completely different work.
why_useful: Consistent quality no matter who runs it or when
Works across every Project, not just this one
Written once, reused forever — no re-explaining the method
Claude asks the right questions before it starts building

without.label: WITHOUT THE SKILL
points: Generic slides, no point of view
Different result every time you ask

with.label: WITH THE SKILL
points: Pops up a short brief and waits
Shaped by your answers, not its guess
Follows a proven structure and design standard
Hands you a real .pptx file to edit

reveal.insight: Same request, same facts, same Minion. The only thing that changed is the Skill.
reveal.reuse: And this Skill is not about Minions. Point it at a product launch, a strategy review, or a quarterly update and it works exactly the same way. You wrote it once.

mission_check: Asked for a presentation with no Skill and kept the result
Downloaded the Skill file and installed it in Claude
Carried my findings into a new chat and asked again with the Skill attached
Compared both and can name three concrete differences
